title: Rabbi Yose Tzaydenaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Rabbi Yirmeya: Ketubot ch. 1, halakha 7; Nazir, end of ch. 7, where he recited [a teaching] before Rabbi Yirmeya; and so one should read in Nazir ch. 3, halakha 3.
And so we find that he spoke in the name of Rabbi Yohanan in Berakhot ch. 4, halakha 4; and it is possible that he is the one called in Ketubot 46a [by the name] Rav Yosef Tzeidoni.

notes.text: The connection between Yose Tzaydenaya and Rav Yosef Tzidoni is tentative. Hyman does not spell out exactly which part of the Nazir 3:3 wording he would correct.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7, in its final halakha, names Rabbi Yose Tzaydanaya reciting before Rabbi Yirmeyah; an earlier passage there gives the Sidonian epithet without Yose. Berakhot 4:4 names Yose Tzaydanaya reporting Rabbi Yochanan. These occurrences do not establish the tentative identification with Rav Yosef Tzidoni.
